nodes.title: Ridout's $p$-adic extension of Roth's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be an irrational real number that is algebraic over $\mathbb{Q}$, and let $\varepsilon > 0$ be real. Then only finitely many rational numbers $q$ satisfy $|\alpha - q| < 1 / b^{2 + \varepsilon}$, where $b$ is the denominator of $q$ in lowest terms.
